user.title: Configure vehicle
user.description: Choose the calculation that matches your range source. Existing requests and energy accounting are preserved when app data is delayed. Optional vehicle controls are available only with current remaining range.

data.name: Name
data.battery_entity: Energy currently stored in the battery (kWh)

data_description.kind: Choose by the meaning of the range source, regardless of vehicle brand. Current remaining range uses kilometres at the present battery charge. Full range uses a reference at 100% charge and applies SOH.
data_description.range_entity: For current remaining range: remaining kilometres from the vehicle or a helper. For full range: the reference at 100% charge before SOH correction. A helper already calculating remaining range belongs to the first method.
data_description.battery_entity: Select available energy at the current battery charge. Total battery capacity is a different quantity.
data_description.soh_entity: Only the full-range method applies this correction. Remaining range is not corrected for SOH a second time. Without an SOH source, the full-range method uses 100%.
data_description.measurement_time_entity: When the vehicle measured the data. HA reception time is not a substitute. Delayed data does not erase an existing bounded energy allowance.
data_description.limit_writer_entity: Optional and available only with current remaining range. An owned temporary increase requires both this control and explicit permission.
data_description.vehicle_charge_switch_entity: Optional and available only with current remaining range. The control must actually start and stop charging through this vehicle.
data_description.planning_power_kw: Use 0 to follow the normal or safe capacity of the charger. A positive value only caps planning power.

start.name: Start charging request
start.description: With the master off this only simulates. With the master on, control the selected vehicle toward its target and departure.

set_target.name: Set target
set_target.description: Change own target/departure without resetting delivered energy. An inactive change does not start charging.

stop.name: Stop charging request
stop.description: Revoke resume rights and end only owned grid charging. Green remains the baseline.

follow_helpers.name: Follow bound helpers
follow_helpers.description: Remove local target/departure overrides and follow bound helpers without starting a new request.
